0022600029.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2, winners of two straight, 4-0 at home and 2-2 on the road) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-2, losers of two straight, 4-0 on the road and 2-2 at home) in a Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, the Thunder's ninth game of the season. The Thunder are without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Grizzlies are without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won all three games against Memphis in 2025-26, including a 117-116 road win in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
